notes:
May 26th 2026
Version 10.2+ (stable) / 10.4+(beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Modernized main window with card-based layout and a yellow mode-aware title banner that clearly shows whether you're in Roland or Korg mode (R K)
* Modernized front-door dialogs (About, Welcome, Subscribe / Activate, Manual Activation, Live Connection) — consistent dark theme throughout (R K)
* App-wide palette refresh — every dialog and editor surface now uses the same modern dark blue family for a cohesive look (R K)
* Live Editor Master Tune tab: simplified to a single combined card; "Master Tune", "Transpose", and "User Program Filter" terminology now matches the FR-8x manual exactly (R)
* Master Tune frequency display rebuilt with custom rendering so the value and cents subtitle never overlap regardless of window size (R)
* Live Editor: fixed missing Bass & Chord blink indicator on initial open — the sidebar showed OFF even when the accordion's LED was blinking. The workaround was to load another UPG and come back; now the blink shows correctly on the first load (R)
* Subscribe / Activate dialog: fixed cropped button text ("Activate via PayPa", "Ask a Questio") and made "Check Status" visible by default for all users (R K)
* Fixed false "Settings differ from accordion" popup when Alpine, Balkan, or Dallape expansion packs are installed — the comparison was using different names for the same packs (Alpine vs Alpine/Oberkrainer, Balkan vs Balkan/EEU, plus Dallape has no orchestra tones so K-Config genuinely can't detect it via MIDI and now correctly trusts your Settings) (R)
* Live Editor: Global Settings now spans 9 tabs — Master Tune (with inline Transpose + UPG Filter), Scale Tuning, Bellows/Audio, System, Layout (FR-8X only: Bass & Chord Mode + Free Bass Mode), Switches & Pedal (6 Function Switches + 9/15 Foot Controller slots + button-press shortcuts), Sustain (Sust A / Sust B routing per orchestra section), Speaker EQ (FR-4X only: 4-band parametric per Right/Left Hand speaker), and MIDI (R)
* Preferences window reformatted into a two-column layout so the OK button stays visible on smaller Windows screens (R K)
* Subscribe / Activate dialog: new "Ask a Question" button next to Download Update — lets users locked out by activation contact support directly without needing the main menu (R K)
* Fixed giant text in right-click menus on Windows VMs caused by font inheritance from scaled parent dialogs (R K)
* Korg backup tree no longer slowly scrolls on its own (K)
* Fixed a latent bug where simply hovering the cursor near the tree edge would activate the drag-only edge auto-scroll (K)
* Bass editor (FR-8X only): added Voicing control (Accordion / Mode 1 / Mode 2) — matches Roland's own Bass editor, lets you change the bass voicing engine per register (R)
* Live Editor: changing an orchestra tone (Orch 1/2, Orch Chord, Orch Free Bass) now re-syncs the editor with the accordion's auto-applied MFX defaults so the next Send doesn't revert them (R)
